stem: What group comes next? ACE, BDF, CEG, ___
hints: Compare the first letters of the groups, then the second letters, then the third letters.
The first letters are A, B, C. The second letters are C, D, E. The third letters are E, F, G.
Each place moves forward one letter from group to group. Move each letter of CEG forward by one.

solution.methodName: Change letters to numbers, then find the rule

steps.action: Look inside one group: A, C, E skips one letter each time (A, skip B, C, skip D, E).
steps.why: Every group is built the same way, so this tells you what the new group must look like.

steps.action: Compare the groups place by place. First letters: A, B, C. Second letters: C, D, E. Third letters: E, F, G.
Each place moves forward by 1 from one group to the next. The rule is +1.
Move each letter of CEG forward by 1: C becomes D, E becomes F, G becomes H.
The next group is DFH. Check: D, skip E, F, skip G, H. The answer is DFH.

trapNotes.DEF: DEF has no skipped letters inside it. Every group skips one letter between its letters, like A, C, E.
trapNotes.EGI: EGI moves each letter forward by 2. From ACE to BDF, each letter moves forward by only 1.
trapNotes.DGJ: DGJ skips two letters inside the group. The groups skip only one letter each time.
